caption: The drawing depicts a rural landscape scene bordered by a black rectangular frame, set against an off-white background. The primary colors used are shades of turquoise-blue, white, pink, and brown. On the left side, there is a house with a pitched roof and visible windows outlined in white and pink. A winding path and a stream run from the lower left foreground to a central pond or lake, with white swans or ducks swimming. Several trees with white trunks and branches and green-brown foliage are scattered throughout the scene. A stone bridge with arches crosses the water near the center, in front of a large building or manor house on the right, characterized by rectangular windows, pink details, and crenellated rooflines. In the foreground near the water, there are cows and sheep, some grazing, rendered in shades of pink and white. There are also a few human figures near the water’s edge, depicted in a simplified style, and what appears to be a deer to the right. The background shows a mix of conifer and deciduous trees in silhouette, with the sky filled with a solid turquoise color.
title: Wallpaper from Bandbox Covering
